title: Assets ledger tool input
description: The subset of a Document Engine result envelope this tool reads. The tool receives the whole verified envelope; this schema names the parts it actually consumes, so a release pinning the tool is pinning a stated dependency on the engine's bank-statement extraction rather than on the envelope as a whole. Repeating rows are identified by a non-null groupKey: one group is one transaction.

documents.description: Logical documents in envelope order. Only those whose documentTypeCode is configured as a statement type are read; the rest are ignored, not an error.

name.description: Matched against the configured account and transaction field names.

groupKey.description: Null for a field that does not repeat, which makes it an account header field. Non-null groups the field into one transaction row.

normalized.description: Typed arms. Only these are read; rawValue is never parsed, because re-parsing a value the engine already normalized is how two systems come to disagree about the same number.
